demographic_coefficient_reliability.use: Do not interpret the many-category coefficients in the 65-person-month same-input sample; retain as numerical diagnostics only.

regression.interpretation: WLS with month fixed effects and demographic categories. Repeats averaged only for regression; months equal weight. Descriptive in-sample associations, no identified update gain, no p-values or causal claims. Prior measurement error, leverage and sparse groups remain.

limits: All groups and regressions are exploratory, conditional on these inspected months and common complete replies.
Group summaries average available month/repeat cells with n>=8; compare only within the same subgroup.
Age, numeracy, income and education overlap; subgroup patterns are not independent mechanisms.
Current truth update groups are outcome-selected; copy accuracy there is partly mechanical, not a targeting rule.
